## Summary

**Fixed test:** `shows custom exercises from IndexedDB when adding to EMOM block` in `timed-block-exercise-picker.spec.ts`

**Issue:** The test was failing in Happy-DOM mode because it didn't wait for the tab content to render after switching to the "Timed Blocks" tab. The test immediately tried to click the EMOM button, and also looked for a dialog title "Configure" when the actual title was "Configure EMOM".

2. Fixed the configure dialog assertion to use a regex pattern matching the actual dialog title: `await expectElement(page.getByText(/configure emom/i)).toBeVisible()`

**Verification:**
- Happy-DOM: Test passes ✅
- Browser mode: Test passes ✅
